title: Check a desktop IPC sender
responsibility: Accept messages only from the expected window main frame at an allowed URL.

inputs.name: trustedSender.event
inputs.description: The IPC invocation's sender and sender frame. Trust requires the sender to be this window's webContents and the frame to be its mainFrame, with the frame URL accepted by NavigationValidator.validate.

inputs.name: trustedSender.window
inputs.description: The expected Electron window, whose webContents and webContents.mainFrame are compared by object identity with the event's sender fields.

outputs.name: trustedSender
outputs.description: True only when event.sender is window.webContents, event.senderFrame is window.webContents.mainFrame, and NavigationValidator.validate accepts event.senderFrame?.url; otherwise false.
